transcript.text: Welcome to on Print Shop, Today we will see how to add a corporate in your admin panel.
To add a corporate in your admin panel you will need to go to corporate management corporates and click on add button.
Then you will need to add the corporate details like corporate name, then to e-mail address of the corporate on which the corporate will receive the e-mail from their customer.
Then from e-mail address of the corporate from which the emails will be sent to their customer and you can also add a reply to e-mail address if required.
Then comes the directory name.
Then directory name is auto generated and it works as a URL of the corporate just like this one over here.
Demobank is the directory name so it works as a corporate URL so it is auto generated.
Then comes a corporate logo.
So you can upload a logo file of the corporate from here.
So corporate logo will be uploaded.
Then comes the name of the master admin, user name of the master admin, password of the master admin, phone number of the master admin and select sales season if required.
Then comes the configuration settings.
So in configuration settings if you don't want to provide the configuration settings what you provide to the retail store, then you can select the custom settings from here.
Otherwise you can keep it on default.
Then comes the content settings.
So in content settings for example, we take banner.
So if you select for all then it will be the banners which will be available to all retailers or all corporates.
And if you select only corporate then the banner which will be available to this corporate will be only visible to this particular corporate like this for example, this is the banner over here.
So this banner is only for this particular corporate.
So to add the banner like this for only this particular corporate, you can select only corporate and likewise you can also set the other content settings over here.
Then comes the pay on account.
So pay on account virtualize the credit limit.
So you can provide a credit limit or a pay on account limit from here.
So to activate this pay on account payment method you will need to go to admin panel and from store configuration you will need to go to payment method and activate Pyeon account payment method.
Then and only then you will be able to make available the Pyeon account to your customers.
So you can add the Pyeon account limit to your corporate customer or even you can give it the Pyeon account limit to your retail customers.
When you are adding the retail customers then comes the department.
So for example a corporate has a multiple department like say loan department or marketing department or admin department.

So to add the departments you will need to activate this department button and when you activate this department button it will when a corporate logs in in the department he will have a drop down like this to select the particular department in which he is employed for.
So this is how you can add the department.
Then comes the fixed billing address and fixed shipping address.
So if the corporate has a fixed billing address and a fixed shipping address then you can activate this fixed billing address and fixed shipping address buttons.
Otherwise keep them inactive.
Then comes the order approval.
So in many corporate cases, it is required that if their employee places an order, that order needs to be approved by the master admin.
So in that case you can activate this button.
When you activate this button, when the customer of this particular corporate logs into their account and places an order, they will receive a message like say order approval pending.

From here like say order is placed but the approval for the order is pending and the master admin when logs into his account you will receive these kind of message over here that approval of these orders are pending and he can give approval from here.
So this is how order approval works.
Then comes the show prices to the customer.
So if you don't want to show prices to your customer in the corporate account, then you can inactivate this button and you can add the alternative price tags over here.
Then comes the enable authorization for registering the user.
So for example, your customer of the corporate registers from his corporate account page from here.
Then he will need a authorization of the master admin to register with this particular corporate.
So to enable that authorization for the master admin, you can activate this button.
Otherwise you can keep it inactive.
Then comes a quick checkout.
So normally what happens is that when customer logs in to their corporate account, they will go taken to a page which is normal like say homepage for the particular corporate.
But if the quick checkout page is activated from here, then when customer logs into the account, it'll be directly taken to the quick checkout page.
Over here you can see the quick checkout page and you can directly select the particular product and place the order.
Then comes the corporate profiling.
So in corporate profiling, when you activate this corporate profiling, the customer of your corporate needs to go to their account.
From my account, they will need to select corporate profile from here.
And they will need to Add all the corporate profile details over here which will be absorbed automatically by the PDF block template in the designer studio.
And they will not need to each and every time add their details in the templates.
So this is how corporate profiling works.
So you can activate corporate profiling from here either no or optional or you can make it mandatory.
Then comes the notification button.
So in the notification button you can activate this button if you want to send one time notification to the master admin of the corporate with their username and password.
And then comes the status.
Of course the status will be active and then you can click on save button and the corporate will be added.
So this is how you can add a corporate to your admin panel.
Thank you for watching this video.
